# StaffKit (binary)

Private. Prebuilt XCFrameworks of StaffKit, the staff side of the AudienceKit SDK, for iOS 16+ and macOS 13+. They
include the AudienceKit SDK modules (`AudienceCore`, `AudienceKit`, `AudienceKitUI`) StaffKit was built against.
Generated by `scripts/build-binaries.sh` in [lwm-luminx/staff-kit](https://github.com/lwm-luminx/staff-kit) (see its
`docs/BINARY_PACKAGE.md`). Don't edit `Package.swift` here.

## Installing

The frameworks are this repository's release assets, so Swift Package Manager downloads them through the GitHub API with
a token that can read this repository. Put it in `~/.netrc` on every machine that resolves the package:

```
machine api.github.com
  login x-access-token
  password <GitHub token with Contents: Read on lwm-luminx/staff-kit-binaries>
machine github.com
  login x-access-token
  password <the same token>
```

The `github.com` entry lets git clone this private repository; the `api.github.com` one downloads the frameworks. On
Xcode Cloud, write the same file in `ci_scripts/ci_post_clone.sh` from a secret environment variable.

Then add the package:

```swift
.package(url: "https://github.com/lwm-luminx/staff-kit-binaries.git", from: "1.0.0")
```

and depend on the product you need:

| Product | Modules it brings |
| --- | --- |
| `StaffKit` | Everything below: the umbrella, `import StaffKit` |
| `StaffKitCore` | AudienceCore, StaffKitCore |
| `StaffOnboarding` | AudienceCore, StaffKitCore, StaffOnboarding: what an App Clip links |
| `StaffKitServices` | StaffKitCore and ArbiterModels, plus the staff API clients |
| `StaffKitUI` | StaffKitServices and AudienceKitUI, plus the staff SwiftUI |
| `ArbiterModels`, `ArbiterUI` | Arbiter's types and its SwiftUI |
| `AudienceCore`, `AudienceKit`, `AudienceKitUI` | The AudienceKit SDK modules StaffKit was built against |

Don't also add `lwm-luminx/audience-kit-sdk` from source: take AudienceKit from this package, or the app ends up with
two copies of `AudienceCore`.
